claim_checks.note: Disclosures are made on a copy of the Real Estate Transfer Disclosure Statement form; matches Civ. Code 1102.6(a) ledger text.
Article applies, except as provided in 1102.2, to a transfer by sale of single-family residential property; matches ledger and keeps the exception.
Any waiver of the article's requirements is void as against public policy; matches 1102(c). 'No agreeing your way around it' adds no scope.
